sites.name: Carnac alignments
sites.era: ancient (era not stated on the pages read)
sites.what: Megalithic alignments with the Maison des mégalithes visitor building.

access.opening: Maison des mégalithes 1 Oct to 31 Mar 10:00 to 13:00 and 14:00 to 17:00; longer hours April to September.
access.tickets: Guided visit €13 (about A$20.66 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026). Free access to the pedestrian path around the sites; some sites open for free visits October to end of March.
access.permits: No permit stated; dogs not allowed on guided visits.
